mapper.sql: select e.exposure_no, e.customer_no, e.customer_name_snapshot as customer_name, e.contract_no, e.debt_no, e.drawdown_no, e.product_type, e.ead_amount, e.exposure_balance, e.collateral_value, e.guaranteed_amount, e.lgd_avg, e.lgd_downturn, e.pd, e.el_avg, e.el_downturn, e.product_recovery_rate, e.rating_result, e.five_category, e.risk_level, e.overdue_days, e.default_flag, e.measurement_date, e.data_date, e.model_name, e.model_version, e.scenario_type, ifnull(c.industry_name, '未分类') as industry_name, ifnull(c.owner_org_name, '') as owner_org_name, round(e.lgd_downturn - e.lgd_avg, 6) as lgd_gap, case when e.ead_amount > 0 then round((e.collateral_value + e.guaranteed_amount) / e.ead_amount, 6) else null end as coverage_rate, round(e.ead_amount * e.lgd_downturn, 2) as downturn_loss_exposure from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 where e.deleted_flag = 0 and e.exposure_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(ead_amount), 0) as ead_amount_total, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_avg) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_avg, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_downturn) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_downturn, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * product_recovery_rate) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_recovery_rate, ifnull(sum(el_avg), 0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(el_downturn), 0) as el_downturn_amount, ifnull(sum(case when lgd_downturn >= 0.600000 then ead_amount else 0 end), 0) as high_lgd_ead_amount, ifnull(sum(lgd_downturn >= 0.600000), 0) as high_lgd_exposure_count, ifnull(sum(product_recovery_rate < 0.400000), 0) as low_recovery_exposure_count, ifnull(sum(default_flag = 1), 0) as default_exposure_count, max(data_date) as latest_data_date from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE'

select product_type, count(*) as exposure_count, ifnull(sum(ead_amount), 0) as ead_amount, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_avg) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_avg, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_downturn) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_downturn, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * product_recovery_rate) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_recovery_rate, ifnull(sum(el_avg), 0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(el_downturn), 0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by product_type order by ead_amount desc, product_type

select ifnull(c.industry_name, '未分类') as industry_name, count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct e.customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount), 0) as ead_amount, case when sum(e.ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(e.ead_amount * e.lgd_avg) / sum(e.ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_avg, case when sum(e.ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(e.ead_amount * e.lgd_downturn) / sum(e.ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_downturn, ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn), 0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 where e.deleted_flag = 0 and e.exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by ifnull(c.industry_name, '未分类') order by ead_amount desc, weighted_lgd_downturn desc

sql.if: and (e.customer_no like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%') or e.customer_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%') or e.contract_no like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%') or e.debt_no like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select e.exposure_no, e.customer_no, e.customer_name_snapshot as customer_name, e.contract_no, e.debt_no, e.drawdown_no, e.product_type, e.ead_amount, e.exposure_balance, e.collateral_value, e.guaranteed_amount, e.lgd_avg, e.lgd_downturn, e.pd, e.el_avg, e.el_downturn, e.product_recovery_rate, e.rating_result, e.five_category, e.risk_level, e.overdue_days, e.default_flag, e.measurement_date, e.data_date, e.model_name, e.model_version, e.scenario_type, ifnull(c.industry_name, '未分类') as industry_name, ifnull(c.owner_org_name, '') as owner_org_name, round(e.lgd_downturn - e.lgd_avg, 6) as lgd_gap, case when e.ead_amount > 0 then round((e.collateral_value + e.guaranteed_amount) / e.ead_amount, 6) else null end as coverage_rate, round(e.ead_amount * e.lgd_downturn, 2) as downturn_loss_exposure from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 where e.deleted_flag = 0 and e.exposure_status = 'ACTIVE'
order by downturn_loss_exposure desc, e.debt_no limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 where e.deleted_flag = 0 and e.exposure_status = 'ACTIVE'
select * from () ledger where debt_no = #{debtNo} order by data_date desc limit 1

select rel.contract_no, co.collateral_no, co.collateral_name, co.collateral_type, co.confirmed_value, co.available_secured_amount, rel.secured_amount, rel.pledge_rate, rel.relation_status from corporate_credit_drawdown d join corporate_credit_contract_collateral rel on rel.contract_no = d.contract_no_snapshot and rel.deleted_flag = 0 and rel.relation_status = 'ACTIVE' join corporate_credit_collateral co on co.collateral_no = rel.collateral_no and co.deleted_flag = 0 where d.debt_no = #{debtNo} and d.deleted_flag = 0 order by co.confirmed_value desc

select overdue_no, overdue_date, overdue_days, total_overdue_amount, remaining_overdue_amount, repayment_status, collection_status from corporate_credit_overdue where debt_no = #{debtNo} and deleted_flag = 0 order by overdue_date desc, id desc limit 20

select debt_default_no, default_level, default_date, overdue_days, default_exposure_amount, loss_amount, default_status from corporate_debt_default where debt_no = #{debtNo} and deleted_flag = 0 order by default_date desc, id desc limit 20

select customer_no, max(customer_name_snapshot) as customer_name, count(*) as exposure_count, ifnull(sum(ead_amount), 0) as ead_amount_total, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_avg) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_avg, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * lgd_downturn) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_lgd_downturn, case when sum(ead_amount) > 0 then round(sum(ead_amount * product_recovery_rate) / sum(ead_amount), 6) else 0 end as weighted_recovery_rate, ifnull(sum(el_avg), 0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(el_downturn), 0) as el_downturn_amount, max(overdue_days) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(sum(default_flag = 1), 0) as default_exposure_count from corporate_risk_exposure where customer_no = #{customerNo} and deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no
select date_format(max(data_date), '%Y-%m-%d') from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE'

select id, version_code, version_name, status, source_description, created_by, approved_by, approved_at, effective_date, created_at, updated_at from risk_lgd_model_version where status = 'PUBLISHED' order by effective_date desc, id desc limit 1

select id, version_code, version_name, status, source_description, created_by, approved_by, approved_at, effective_date, created_at, updated_at from risk_lgd_model_version order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, version_id, segment_type, segment_code, segment_name, lgd_avg, lgd_downturn, recovery_rate, collateral_haircut, enabled, created_at, updated_at from risk_lgd_segment_parameter where version_id = #{versionId} order by segment_type, segment_code
mapper.insert: insert into risk_lgd_model_version (version_code, version_name, status, source_description, created_by, approved_by, approved_at, effective_date) values (#{version_code}, #{version_name}, #{status}, #{source_description}, #{created_by}, #{approved_by}, #{approved_at}, #{effective_date})

insert into risk_lgd_segment_parameter (version_id, segment_type, segment_code, segment_name, lgd_avg, lgd_downturn, recovery_rate, collateral_haircut, enabled) values (#{version_id}, #{segment_type}, #{segment_code}, #{segment_name}, #{lgd_avg}, #{lgd_downturn}, #{recovery_rate}, #{collateral_haircut}, #{enabled})

insert into risk_lgd_calculation_run (model_version_id, run_type, source_data_date, exposure_count, ead_amount, weighted_lgd_avg, weighted_lgd_downturn, el_avg_amount, el_downturn_amount, result_summary, run_by) values (#{model_version_id}, #{run_type}, #{source_data_date}, #{exposure_count}, #{ead_amount}, #{weighted_lgd_avg}, #{weighted_lgd_downturn}, #{el_avg_amount}, #{el_downturn_amount}, #{result_summary}, #{run_by})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.run_type, r.source_data_date, r.exposure_count, r.ead_amount, r.weighted_lgd_avg, r.weighted_lgd_downturn, r.el_avg_amount, r.el_downturn_amount, r.result_summary, r.run_by, r.created_at, v.version_code, v.version_name from risk_lgd_calculation_run r left join risk_lgd_model_version v on v.id = r.model_version_id order by r.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_lgd_stress_test_run (scenario_code, scenario_name, parameter_json, summary_json, run_by) values (#{scenario_code}, #{scenario_name}, #{parameter_json}, #{summary_json}, #{run_by})
mapper.select: select id, scenario_code, scenario_name, parameter_json, summary_json, run_by, created_at from risk_lgd_stress_test_run order by id desc limit #{limit}
